title: diodia teres subsp. prostrata
intro: Diodia teres subsp. prostrata, commonly known as creeping buttonbush, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to the southeastern United States. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of creeping buttonbush include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can aid in wound healing and muscle relaxation. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
